dog.description_text:
Soft as a little cloud and sweet as can be, Cotton is the kind of puppy who seems to bring a little sunshine wherever she goes.

Her beautiful white-and-sandy coloring gives her a warm, almost sun-kissed look, perfectly matching the gentle charm of her name. But Cotton is more than just a pretty face - she’s a tiny personality in the making - full of puppy curiosity, playful moments, and an irresistible sweetness that makes you want to scoop her right up.

Rescued from Louisiana, thanks to our rescue partner BISSELL, Cotton has that soft, comforting presence you can imagine curled up beside you after a day of adventures, while still having plenty of puppy spirit ready to bounce into whatever comes next.

Come meet Cotton - your future favorite cuddle buddy, adventure companion, and sweetest little shadow.
